_about: Public-domain William Kelly (1821-1906, Plymouth Brethren scholar and editor of Darby) for the Word Hoard: 29 books of exposition and lectures, 1858-1916, from Internet Archive scans, covering the Pentateuch, Job, Isaiah, Daniel, the Gospels, Romans, Galatians, Ephesians, Hebrews, James and the Revelation. Shelf name keeps him apart from other William Kellys. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 20 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
